pr_title: [Button] Fix theme elements size rounding errors not keeping sufficient space for the text.

issue_context.title: Text clipping on buttons when using a custom display scale
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions Current master v4.3.dev.custom_build [4728ff30c] ### System information Godot v4.3.dev (4728ff30c) - macOS 14.4.0 - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max - Apple M1 Max (10 Threads) ### Issue description I thought it was fixed but apparently it's back?
Audi makes nice cars but the tab isn't about them unfortunately ### Steps to reproduce Just set the display scale to 1.6. No custom theme ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
comments:
I thought maybe it would make sense to make some kind of a checklist for testing UI-related PRs to prevent regressions because custom display scale bugs are consistently getting missed. I have these other two opened as well:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/89482
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/89718

Seems like a rounding error in the theme element size calculations. In case of "Audio" text buffer return width `61` in the min. size calculation, but after adding and subtracting theme margins and style box sizes only `60.9999961853027` is left for the text.

review_comments:
Should it be `round()` to avoid errors on the other end where `62.000000047` would become `63`?
Or is it better to err on the side of caution and have one too many pixels instead of one too few?

An extra pixel in the text buffer should not be an issue (it's setting max. width available for the string), so always ceiling is probably safer (I'm not sure how big the error can get since a lot of code is involved in control size calculations).
